title: Correct labels on matched examples
statement: Let $n,k,M\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $P\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix an assignment $z$ on $P$. Let $\delta$ satisfy $0<\delta\le\tfrac12$. If an outcome of the program's run has first component equal to a batch of $M$ matched examples, then for every example in that batch its label equals the value of the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing $P$ according to $z$ and using that example's remaining coordinates as input.
hypotheses_covered: Outcome belongs to the support of the program run
Outcome's first component is the specified batch
